title: The Evidence Anchoring Boundary: Where Visual Interventions Matter and When They Help in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Visual interventions provide a training-free way to reduce hallucinations in multimodal large language models. However, an intervention may have little leverage at some layers and may damage a correct answer even when it changes the output. We investigate where visual interventions retain leverage and when they improve predictions. First, we apply the same visual-residual edit at successive decoder layers, matching its RMS strength across depth. Across six checkpoints from three model families, we observe a persistent drop in intervention effect and define its operational onset for this edit as the \textbf{Evidence Anchoring Boundary (EAB)}. With boundaries fixed on calibration queries, held-out effects on disjoint evaluation queries before EAB are $13.78\times$--$26.10\times$ larger than those after it. Comparison with intermediate readouts shows that the edit can lose leverage before answer preferences stabilize. Second, we compare counterfactual subtraction across presence, attribute, and relation questions. Subtraction can correct a misleading preference, leave a decision unchanged, or remove a preference supporting the correct answer. Based on these observations, we develop calibrated selective routing, which preserves the original prediction unless calibration supports an intervention for the question type. It improves full-set attribute accuracy by $1.56$--$1.81$ percentage points across three checkpoints, while universal subtraction is neutral or harmful.

AI.brief_summary: 研究多模态 LLM 中视觉干预在解码器不同深度的有效范围，提出 Evidence Anchoring Boundary（EAB）刻画同强度视觉残差编辑的效应随层深骤降的位置，并比较 presence/attribute/relation 问题上的反事实减法，进而提出按问题类型校准的选择性路由。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关系视觉证据在内部状态中的保留位置与因果作用：EAB 提供「视觉贡献在何处失效」的可核查线索，反事实减法区分纠正偏好与破坏正确答案，选择性路由涉及何时采用视觉证据，对 latent 状态的深度—证据对应与证据筛选有参考价值。

title: CV-OPD: Contrastive Vision On-policy Distillation
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, contrastive learning for on-policy distillation of VLMs. Computer Vision. Post-training. VLM. LLM
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) reveals versatility and convenience during VLM post-training, providing dense supervision for student from teacher. However, we observed an anomaly that the distilled VLM could still answer the questions accurately even when the related visual regions were masked or replaced with noise. Building on this observation, our quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that OPD, which uses the answer as a hint, has failed to teach students to genuinely seek out and rely on visual evidence. Our theoretical analysis suggests that this failure arises from a shortcut enabled by the lack of visual constraints during distillation. To address the issue, we introduce Contrastive Vision On-policy Distillation (CV-OPD), which compares teacher distributions induced by positive and negative crops while conditioning on the same student prefix and augments optimization with a margin-based contrastive constraint, which is modulated with discrepancy gating across token and sample level. Specifically, CV-OPD first introduces a negative teacher unrelated to the answer and designs a Contrastive Divergence Loss (CDL) that constrains the feature distribution of student by contrasting the positive and negative teachers, correcting how the student exploits visual regions. The CV-OPD introduces a Discrepancy Aware Gate (DAG) that uses token-level and sample-level discrepancies to select visually relevant tokens for optimization, directing the student's attention toward visual content. Extensive experiments across a broad range of fine-grained visual benchmarks demonstrate that CV-OPD substantially alleviates shortcut and consistently improves the visual reasoning capabilities of existing VLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文发现 VLM 在 on-policy distillation（OPD）后，即使相关视觉区域被遮挡或替换为噪声仍能正确作答，据此指出 OPD 以答案为提示的训练未能让学生真正依赖视觉证据；为此提出 CV-OPD，用正负 crop 诱导的教师分布构造对比散度损失，并借 token 级与样本级差异门控挑选视觉相关 token 参与优化。

title: S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models
summary: Multimodal language models (MLLMs) exhibit promising spatial reasoning capabilities, yet the internal mechanisms supporting them remain poorly understood. We uncover S-Space, a linear representation subspace in which object-token representations encode continuous coordinates along horizontal, vertical, and distance axes. Although we identify these axes by differentiating spatial-answer scores with respect to object-token activations, S-Space is intrinsic rather than induced by specific data or prompts, remaining readable under non-spatial questions. We show that S-Space functions as an internal spatial workspace of MLLMs. Perception encodes object locations into it, forming spatial representations that can be directly read out to support accurate spatial judgments. Internal reasoning transforms it for changing viewpoints. Verbal responses selectively access it, evidenced by causal interventions that alter spatial judgments while largely preserving non-spatial responses. Case studies further show that S-Space assigns locations to unseen entities and the observer, and connects physical directions with abstract linguistic meanings, suggesting both the capabilities and limitations of large-scale language training. Finally, we use S-Space as a diagnostic tool for spatial reasoning failures. Direction-word readouts reveal systematic coupling between cardinal and image-relative reference frames. More importantly, a perception-computation decomposition exposes a key bottleneck: MLLMs can form capable spatial representations, yet fall short in the spatial transformations required to reason reliably across viewpoint changes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文识别出 MLLM 内部一个线性子空间「S-Space」，其中物体 token 表示沿水平、垂直、距离轴编码连续坐标，并通过消融与因果干预论证它充当内部空间工作区，可作为诊断空间推理失败的工具。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应视觉几何信息是否保留在内部状态、latent 表示能否被读出并因果支持答案；其感知—计算分解所指出的视角变换瓶颈，与 LVR 关注的状态可读性、latent 内容使用和失败诊断高度重合，值得优先核查。

title: Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 IG-VLA：在视觉表示空间中对任务相关的未来场景演化做 latent 时空推理以指导动作预测，并用紧凑的 Scene Gist Token 将推理内化，使推理时无需显式未来想象，在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、VLABench 上验证成功率与效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线直接相关：推理状态在视觉 latent 空间中生成与更新，并显式考察「推理期是否仍需生成 latent」的收益与成本；可供核查场景 gist token 是否保留任务必要视觉信息，以及 latent 推理对动作决策的因果贡献。

title: TerraAgent: Demonstration-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Long-Context Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering
summary: Remote sensing visual question answering (RS-VQA) requires answers that truly depend on image evidence, yet current remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS MLLMs) are still evaluated mainly by accuracy, which cannot reveal whether a correct answer was produced without using the image. This setting introduces three challenges: demonstrations retrieved across different ground sample distances (GSD), sensors, and city textures may be poorly matched; real queries often involve long visual contexts from multi-scale tiles, multi-temporal frames, and retrieved knowledge, where evidence can be diluted and errors can propagate through multi-step reasoning; and prior-only answering remains invisible to standard metrics. We present AVA, a training-free framework that wraps a frozen RS MLLM with three modules. GDR performs GSD-bucketed, scene-graph-based demonstration retrieval and filters demonstrations whose answers are unsupported by their images. MACE decomposes each query into an evidence-typed sub-question DAG, routes sub-questions to suitable perception tools, and records verified provenance in a shared evidence ledger with bounded re-perception. CVA audits the final answer through counterfactual perturbations of cited evidence, including ablation and swap, and computes a visual-dependency score for confidence calibration and evidence-forcing re-query. On RSVQA-LR/HR, VRSBench, and LHRS-Bench, AVA improves average accuracy by up to 2.40 points over the strongest same-setting baselines, raises the visual-dependency score from 0.28 to 0.49, reduces the prior-only answer rate from 46.2 percent to 21.7 percent, and lowers the hallucination rate from 17.1 percent to 9.8 percent, with 2.6x the cost of a single backbone forward pass and no fine-tuning.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出训练无关的 AVA 框架，为冻结的遥感 MLLM 外挂三个模块：按 GSD 分桶并过滤图像不支持的示例检索、把查询分解为证据类型子问题 DAG 并路由到感知工具、对引用证据做消融与替换的反事实审计；在多个 RS-VQA 基准上提升了精度与视觉依赖分数，并降低 prior-only 与幻觉率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心问题正是「正确答案是否真的用了图像证据」，视觉依赖分数与反事实审计可供核查 LVR 的视觉旁路、信息坍缩与答案证据归因，多步子问题路由与证据账本也与证据获取和停止/重感知决策相关。

title: Mind the Temporal Gap: Evaluating Video Models for Temporal Understanding in Driving
summary: Modern video-language models are increasingly treated as general-purpose video reasoners, yet it remains unclear whether they robustly capture temporal dynamics in safety-critical settings such as driving. We study this question through controlled ego-motion tasks that require identifying actions from driving videos. Across video-language models, we find that standard prompting, visual prompting, few-shot prompting, and chain-of-thought prompting remain unreliable and highly task- and model-dependent, with persistent class biases, although newer models show substantial task-specific few-shot gains. In contrast, lightweight LoRA finetuning and simple probes trained on intermediate visual features recover strong motion-discriminative performance, indicating that motion-relevant cues are often present inside the models but are not reliably used by the final video-to-language pathway. These results suggest that, in driving, current video-language models remain unreliable temporal reasoners and often behave more like frame-level, bias-driven recognizers than dependable temporal world models.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用受控 ego-motion 驾驶视频任务考察视频语言模型的时序理解，比较标准/视觉/few-shot/思维链提示与 LoRA 微调、中间视觉特征探针，发现提示方式结果不稳定且存在类别偏置，而微调与线性探针能恢复较强的运动判别性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 探针结果表明运动判别信息常存在于中间视觉特征中，却未被最终 video-to-language 路径可靠使用，可能对应 LVR 关注的视觉旁路与内部状态信息未被答案利用问题，其诊断与探针设计可供核查。

title: Feature Competition and Its Representational Origins in Vision Language Models: Evidence from the Stroop Paradigm
summary: When you ask a vision-language model (VLM) a question with an image, it answers your question based on the image. But to act means to choose: saying one thing means choosing to respond not say another. This becomes an issue when the image contains multiple features that equally relate to the question at hand: how would VLMs choose to respond? This problem is precisely studied by the classical Stroop task in psychology: among a set of deliberately designed images whose text and color conflicts (e.g., \textcolor{blue}{RED}), participants are instructed to report the color. We adapt this psychological paradigm to a benchmark and prompted a range of contrastive and generative VLMs on their behavior. Across models, we observe a persistent bias toward the feature of text in Stroop images: when text and color disagree, models preferentially generate responses centered to the text rather than color. We then opened the black box and examined the source of this bias and why certain features influences the model's behavior more than others. In the embedding space, we found that textual cues are represented more strongly and separably than color cues. This representational asymmetry predicts intervention success: steering models toward text-related directions is substantially easier than steering them toward color-related directions. Using a classical psychological paradigm, we demonstrate, at both behavioral and representational levels, that distinct features within the same image can exert unequal influence on VLM behavior. Our findings suggest that VLMs assign different degrees of saliency to different features within the same image, highlighting the need to understand how cue-specific saliency shapes their performance in widely used downstream applications.

AI.brief_summary: 把心理学的 Stroop 范式改造为基准，测试对比式与生成式 VLM 在文本与颜色冲突图像上的作答偏好，并结合嵌入空间分析与引导干预追溯这种特征的来源。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「文本线索表示更强更可分、更易被引导」的结论直接涉及 VLM 是否真正保留并使用视觉细节，可供核查特征显著性、视觉旁路与信息坍缩如何影响推理期证据选择。

title: CaptchaAgent: Verifiable Visual Reasoning for CAPTCHA Solving
comment: 12-page main paper with 7 figures and 4 tables; 5-page supplementary material included
summary: Modern reasoning CAPTCHAs require fine-grained perception, compositional relation reasoning, and grounded browser interaction. End-to-end vision-language model agents remain brittle in this setting because a missed object, incorrect count, or confused relation can propagate directly to the final action. To address this problem, we present CaptchaAgent, a structured visual reasoning framework for interactive CAPTCHA solving. Instead of predicting an action directly from a screenshot, CaptchaAgent first constructs a visual intermediate representation (V-IR) that explicitly records entities, attributes, and spatial or topological relations. A symbol-only ASCII protocol further requires the parser to commit to a concrete object set and count. Building on this global representation, localized evidence refinement revisits ambiguous regions at higher effective resolution, while counterfactual consistency verification tests whether the resulting action remains stable under task-preserving transformations. Across three proprietary backbones on Open CaptchaWorld, CaptchaAgent improves Pass@1 by 21.3-25.8 percentage points over a commercially available browser agent baseline evaluated with the same backbones. On the separate offline Oedipus-data benchmark, it further improves average Pass@1 by 9.2-12.3 percentage points over the Oedipus solver across three matched backbones. The intermediate traces show that exact counting, continuous geometry, and ordered execution remain major sources of automation difficulty for the evaluated agents, providing practical guidance for designing more resilient compositional CAPTCHAs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CaptchaAgent，用结构化视觉推理解决交互式 CAPTCHA：先构建显式记录实体、属性与空间/拓扑关系的视觉中间表示（V-IR），并以仅含符号的 ASCII 协议强制解析器确定对象集合与计数，再通过局部高分辨率证据精修与反事实一致性验证来生成动作。

title: Mind the Spatial Gap: A Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning and Constrained Spatial Editing
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Under Review at ICLR 2027
summary: Understanding and manipulating spatial relations is fundamental to AI systems that reason about physical environments and construct grounded world models. However, existing evaluations of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for spatial reasoning rely predominantly on static question-answering (QA) over small-scale or synthetic scenes, rarely probing whether models can modify spatial configurations while satisfying explicit geometric constraints. We introduce GeoSpatialBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate an escalating progression of spatial cognition, ranging from spatial relation understanding and geometric reasoning to constrained spatial editing. Grounded in real-world urban data across six geographically diverse cities, GeoSpatialBench evaluates a comprehensive taxonomy of 28 topological, directional, metric, and ordering relations across structured GeoJSON and map image modalities, with ground-truth references and constraints verified via GIS operations. Our empirical evaluation across frontier MLLMs uncovers a stark spatial gap: structured GeoJSON consistently outperforms map images, with multimodal combinations offering no reliable gain over GeoJSON alone, and while models show reasonable competence on qualitative topological and ordering, performance drops on quantitative metric relations. Crucially, editing performance on ordering relations declines relative to QA, and most failed edits violate at least one specified spatial constraint. These results highlight a gap between passively recognizing spatial relations and actively manipulating geometric configurations. GeoSpatialBench provides an open, rigorous diagnostic testbed to benchmark these spatial limitations, laying essential empirical groundwork for physically grounded world models and embodied spatial AI.

title: In-Context Learning Can Help Vision-Language Models Overcome Training Priors
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) learn strong statistical regularities during training, which can make them fail to properly respond to visual evidence when input images violate those regularities. It is challenging to disambiguate these prior-induced errors from errors caused by the model missing the underlying visual capabilities. In this work, we use controlled visual in-context learning to encourage the model to focus on the visual evidence, and demonstrate that this alone is frequently sufficient to correct the errors -- suggesting that the models in fact do possess the relevant visual capabilities. Specifically, we show that across five vision-centric tasks, demonstrations yield large gains on prior-conflicting counterfactual examples ($+27.2\%$ for Qwen3-VL 235B and $+15.1\%$ for Qwen3-VL 32B) while leaving accuracy on prior-aligned examples nearly unchanged. These findings generalize across five VLM families with gains from $+9.7\%$ to $+30.3\%$. We analyze visual representations and find that demonstrations indeed redirect attention toward grounding cues while reducing reliance on cues that support the learned prior. Finally, we find that in-context learning is limited when the underlying visual capability is weak or absent. Together, these results show that current VLMs possess visual grounding capabilities that standard evaluations may overlook, underscoring the need for controlled evaluation design in diagnosing and improving model capability.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用受控的视觉 in-context learning（提供示例演示）研究 VLM 在图像违反训练先验时能否依据视觉证据作答，发现演示可大幅纠正先验导致的错误（五个任务上 Qwen3-VL 235B +27.2%、32B +15.1%，跨五个 VLM 家族 +9.7%~+30.3%），且表示分析显示注意被重新导向 grounding 线索；当底层视觉能力弱或缺失时提升有限。

title: MVGraph: Benchmarking LVLMs on Evidence Composition across Multi-View Visual Graph
summary: We introduce MVGraph, a benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models (LVLMs) on multi-graph reasoning where the evidence required by a query is distributed across multiple interrelated visual graph views. Although such evidence commonly resides in source-specific graphs, temporal snapshots, or local observations, existing graph reasoning benchmarks remain confined to a single self-contained structure, assessing only graph perception and reasoning while leaving the alignment and composition of evidence across views underexplored. MVGraph comprises 8k instances spanning 8 \textit{graph-theoretic} tasks, abstracted from two multi-graph scenarios (partial and temporal graph views). Each problem is programmatically constructed and verified to be unsolvable from a single view. Beyond end-to-end evaluation, we decompose multi-graph reasoning into four complementary capabilities---Perception, Alignment, Composition, and Reasoning---and design 29 diagnostic tasks with 64k instances to probe each one, along with golden intermediate representations for evaluating the intermediate process. Across 15 LVLMs, we reveal the difficulty of multi-graph reasoning and identify cross-view edge alignment and relation-level composition as prominent bottlenecks through stage-oriented diagnostics. Meanwhile, temporal constraints and increasing view counts expose further capability boundaries. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AAAndy-Zhu/MVGraph.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MVGraph 基准，评估 LVLM 在多视图视觉图上进行证据组合推理的能力，覆盖部分视图与时间快照两类场景、8k 题目，并拆出感知、对齐、组合、推理四项能力与 29 个诊断任务及中间表示。对 15 个 LVLM 的测试显示跨视图边对齐与关系级组合是主要瓶颈。

title: What Do Visual-Head Discovery Scores Actually Find? Attention Source, Necessity, and Random-Control Pitfalls in Vision-Language Models
summary: Attention heads that attend to image regions relevant to a question are increasingly used to steer, ground and interpret vision-language models (VLMs) and to reduce their hallucinations. They are mostly found by ranking heads with an attention- pattern score and validated by steering or masking them. We ask how the choices inside such a discovery score shape the heads it returns, and which of the two validations identifies them. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct we vary the query type, the discovery corpus and the token positions whose attention is read (the attention source) in a full 2 x 3 x 2 design, and test all 12 head-sets for steerability (CERS: Contrastive Evidence-Region Steering score) and necessity (NCS: Necessity Con- trast Score) against layer-matched random head-sets. (1) The attention source and the query type reshape the selected heads far more than the corpus: changing the source keeps a median of 49 of the top-100 heads, the query 55 and the cor- pus 84, while two halves of the same data share 96-99. (2) Necessity follows the attention source: head-sets discovered from query-span attention are more nec- essary than last-token ones (difference 0.083, p=6 x 10^-10), and the two re- ferring + query-span sets lie 17-19 standard deviations above 250 layer-matched random sets (Holm-adjusted p=0.048). The referring + query-span effect re- plicates on several recent VLMs. (3) Steerability is not specific to the discovered heads: no discovered head-set steers better than its layer-matched random sets (rank p >= 0.14), and random sets drawn from the same or from any layer span the discovered sets' scores. Necessity therefore separates the discovery settings, while steering at this strength does not. We turn these findings into a protocol for reporting visual-head discoveries.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 等 VLM 上系统改变「视觉头」发现分数中的查询类型、发现语料与读取注意力的 token 位置，并用对比式证据区引导（CERS）与必要性对比分（NCS）对照同层随机头集检验选出的头，发现注意力来源与查询类型对选头的影响远大于语料，必要性随来源变化而可复现，而可引导性并不特异地指向被发现的头。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于 VLM 视觉证据筛选与内部状态因果作用的诊断性失败分析：其「必要性有效、steering 不特异」的结论可供核查 LVR 中视觉旁路、注意力结构对 latent 内容判断的影响，以及以引导/遮蔽作为视觉证据使用的验证方式。

title: Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code, prompts and benchmark runner: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench
summary: Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job: a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search's ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full open-domain M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs), +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model, and 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (71.2); on the single-document MMLongBench-Doc it lifts the same model from 34.8 to 47.0, level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3). Per-job ablations on the full benchmarks attribute the gain: the Deep Reader is worth 3.8, 9.8 and 0 points on the three corpora, tracking how visual each is; merging both agents into one with all tools and twice the rounds loses 1.9 F1 because it keeps searching instead of reading; a round-budget sweep shows a step at four Locator rounds and a plateau beyond; query latency scales with model calls rather than corpus size. We serve the three indexed benchmarks as read-only knowledge bases (free registration) and release all prompts and the runner code: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench

AI.brief_summary: 提出 KnowForge，把开放域多模态文档问答拆成只能检索的 Locator、强制第二跳的 bridge judge、有界证据池、只读的 Deep Reader 与合成器，在 M3DocVQA、MultiHop-RAG、MMLongBench-Doc 上做逐角色消融。
AI.relevance_reason: 角色分离与轮数预算消融直接呈现 LOOK/STOP 取舍：合并为单智能体后因持续搜索而非阅读损失 1.9 F1，Deep Reader 增益随语料视觉性变化（3.8/9.8/0），可供核查视觉旁路与停止决策；但属智能体管线层面，未涉及内部 latent 状态。

title: From Glance to Focus: Mitigating Recognition Laziness in MLLMs for Fine-Grained Recognition
comment: 21 pages, 18 figures, 5 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) generally fall short of expectations in Fine-Grained Visual Recognition (FGVR), although they exhibit promising FGVR foundations, i.e., visual perception and broad category knowledge. Most existing studies seek to remedy this deficiency by adopting domain-specific post-training, at the risk of compromising generalization to unseen domains. Different from these efforts, in this paper, we revisit the FGVR mechanism underlying MLLMs from both the empirical and theoretical perspectives and uncover an inference-time phenomenon termed FGVR Laziness. In brief, FGVR Laziness refers to the insufficient association between visual cues and category concepts under certain candidate category lists and recognition guidance, leaving the FGVR foundations of MLLMs largely under-utilized. To mitigate FGVR Laziness, we propose Laziness-resIstant Visual rEcognition (LIVE), a training-free framework which jointly refines candidate lists and recognition guidance to elicit the latent FGVR capability of MLLMs. Specifically, LIVE first performs query-adaptive candidate inference to derive a compact yet reliable candidate list. Meanwhile, LIVE constructs category-specific FGVR skills by mining the intra-category characteristics and inter-category differences. Finally, LIVE selectively invokes detailed skill guidance according to recognition uncertainty and category confusion, shifting MLLM-based FGVR from a cursory glance to a focus on associating discriminative visual cues with category concepts. Extensive experiments on 13 benchmarks against 24 state-of-the-art methods spanning fine-grained category recognition, action recognition, and general category recognition, verify the effectiveness and generalizability of LIVE across different MLLM backbones. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从实证与理论两方面重新审视 MLLM 做细粒度视觉识别（FGVR）的内在机制，指出推理期存在「FGVR Laziness」现象，即视觉线索与类别概念关联不足，并提出免训练的 LIVE 框架：查询自适应地压缩候选类别列表，并依据识别不确定性与类别混淆，选择性调用由类内特征与类间差异构建的技能指导。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心诊断「视觉线索与类别概念关联不足、潜在 FGVR 能力未被利用」对应视觉细节保留与视觉旁路、信息坍缩问题；按不确定性/混淆度选择性触发详细指导，可供核查 THINK/LOOK/STOP 类动态证据获取与停止决策的收益与成本。

title: AdaC-GRPO: Towards Mastering Long-Horizon Visual Sudoku Puzzles via Adaptive Curriculum Learning
summary: While reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models, its efficacy in long-horizon multimodal tasks remains underexplored. Visual Sudoku puzzles pose a representative challenge, requiring multi-step deductive reasoning over both local constraints and global dependency chains. To this end, we introduce FG-Sudoku, a fine-grained benchmark categorized by grid size and required deductive steps. Evaluations reveal that frontier MLLMs fail on complex long-range dependencies (e.g., 9*9 puzzles). During post-training, this near-zero success rate causes severe reward sparsity, halting standard RLVR. We propose Adaptive Curriculum Group Relative Policy Optimization (AdaC-GRPO) to overcome this. Unlike rigid or prior-based schedules, AdaC-GRPO dynamically constructs training batches by tracking the model's "Zone of Proximal Development" via online rollout accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that AdaC-GRPO enables Qwen2.5-VL-7B to approach the performance of Gemini-2.5-Flash while bridging 62.2% of the overall accuracy gap to Gemini-2.5-Pro, with its generalizability further validated across InternVL-3.5 and Qwen3-VL.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建按网格规模与推理步数分级的视觉数独基准 FG-Sudoku，指出前沿 MLLM 在长程依赖上近乎零成功率导致奖励稀疏，并提出 AdaC-GRPO，依据在线 rollout 准确率跟踪「最近发展区」动态构造训练批次。
AI.relevance_reason: 面向 VLM 长程多步视觉推理的训练与评测，其奖励稀疏诊断与按能力动态调度难度的思路，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹训练、监督信号与长度泛化问题；但未涉及内部 latent 状态的生成与使用。

title: OWLET: On-Policy Weighted Learning via Evidence Transfer for Video Large Language Model Post-Training
summary: Post-training has become a key stage for eliciting reasoning capabilities in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs). Existing post-training methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, they do not fully exploit visual evidence for effective training. RL supervises the policy with a single trajectory-level reward, which is too coarse-grained for video reasoning: the same response-level advantage is applied to every generated token, disregarding that the tokens of a video response are grounded in the visual stream to very different degrees. OPD provides token-level supervision through output-distribution matching, but lacks direct supervision of the spatiotemporal representations that produce those outputs. We observe across extensive experiments that the same model reasons more accurately when its video view combines global temporal context with question-relevant details. Comparing the same student-generated response under this view and uniform sampling reveals changes in token likelihoods and internal representations, providing a training signal for evidence use. Building on this observation, we propose OWLET, an evidence-privileged RL method that derives training signals from a richer teacher view. This view couples uniform global context with question-conditioned local windows, providing visual evidence without requiring a larger model. To better exploit this privileged visual evidence, OWLET introduces (i) \textbf{evidence-aware credit redistribution}, which compares token likelihoods across the two views and redistributes positive response-level advantages according to their relative evidence support; and (ii) \textbf{spatiotemporal state alignment}, which aligns the two views' hidden states on verifier-accepted responses.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 OWLET，一种「证据特权」的强化学习后训练方法：用由均匀全局时序上下文与问题相关局部窗口构成的教师视角产生训练信号，并通过 token 级证据感知 credit 重分配与时空隐状态对齐来优化 Video-LLM 策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关联「贡献分配与监督」和视觉证据是否进入内部状态：其 token 级 credit 重分配与在 verifier 接受响应上的隐状态对齐，可供核查视觉证据在推理状态中的保留与使用，以及证据视角差异如何成为监督信号。

title: When MLLMs miss what humans read: diagnosing and learning to read squint text
summary: Multimodal LLMs can fail to read text embedded in an image's coarse structure (text a human recovers by squinting) and report that no text is present. We name this class Squint Text and study it as a recognition deficiency, motivated by cases from a production moderation pipeline. We introduce SquintBench, comprising 1076 production-derived moderation images, and SquintCtrl, a controlled synthetic suite for mechanism diagnosis. Frozen-weight analysis shows that hidden text leaves a coarse signal while glyph identity is weakly represented; identity becomes substantially more accessible when the correct spatial regions are supplied, implicating spatial selection as a major bottleneck. Suppressing high-frequency content also improves reading at a fixed visual-token budget, while visual token count may also contribute. These findings motivate Squint OPSD: a frozen teacher receives a downscaled view and the ground-truth transcription as privileged context, and its token-level distributions supervise a student along on-policy trajectories. At inference, the student reads the original image alone. Squint OPSD reaches 88.61 ANLS on SquintBench, versus 26.50 for the unadapted backbone, 24.44 for the best general-purpose model on the original view, and 68.60 at best for an off-the-shelf model under a downscaled view. These results substantially narrow the gap between available visual evidence and its generated read-out without auxiliary views at inference.

AI.brief_summary: 论文定义「Squint Text」现象：MLLM 读不出图像粗粒度结构中隐藏的文字并声称图中无文字。作者构建 SquintBench 与受控合成集 SquintCtrl，用冻结权重分析定位空间选择为主要瓶颈，并提出 Squint OPSD——以缩小视图加真值标注为特权上下文的冻结教师，沿 on-policy 轨迹对学生做 token 级蒸馏，推理时学生只读原图。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及视觉细节是否保留在内部状态、生成读出是否真正使用视觉证据，以及空间选择与视觉 token 预算的影响；其特权上下文 on-policy 蒸馏线索可供核查训练期监督如何弥合「有视觉证据但未进入生成」的差距。

title: Auditing VLM Benchmarks from Existing Evaluation Runs
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation? (non-archival). Code and artifacts: https://github.com/avos-rnd/vlm-bench
summary: Every evaluation run of a vision-language model (VLM) already produces per-question artifacts (predictions, judged correctness, metadata) that leaderboards reduce to a single score and then discard. We reuse those artifacts to audit the benchmark itself, and add an audit layer to VLMEvalKit: six detectors that run as post-processing over saved outputs, plus one additional text-only rerun with visual inputs removed, emitting a per-question report. The layer reports per-question findings together with aggregate audit statistics; for the headline quantities, it attaches permutation-null excess where applicable, interval estimates for proportions, and sensitivity to the model pool. Auditing MMStar, a benchmark curated specifically so that the image is indispensable, with three models, we find zero aggregate accuracy gain from the image on 20.2% of its questions. An item-matched permutation null accounts for 17.0%, leaving a +3.2 pp excess (corrected permutation p = 0.001). This excess is concentrated in the mathematics and science categories and is absent from coarse perception, a localization consistent with knowledge substituting for visual evidence; confirming that mechanism would require item-level review. A second detector flags 134 questions on which every model that answered in parseable form picked the same non-gold option, and these candidates peak in the perception categories, whereas the zero-gain excess is largest in mathematics and science & technology. Replacing the LLM judge with exact string matching changes no conclusion, and every scoring discrepancy between the two traces to one model whose free-form answers a parser cannot read. On a binary yes/no benchmark the detectors measurably fall out of calibration, a scope boundary that we measure and report. The audit layer, the prediction artifacts and the generated reports accompany this submission.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文复用既有 VLM 评测运行逐题产物，在 VLMEvalKit 上加入审计层（六个后处理检测器，加一次去除图像输入的纯文本重跑），审计 MMStar 等基准，量化图像对准确率的实际贡献并报告不一致题目。
AI.relevance_reason: 依去图像重跑与置换零假设检验视觉证据是否为推理所必需，与 LVR 关注的视觉旁路、证据筛选和评价方法直接相关；其审计协议可供核查多模态推理中「视觉信息是否真被使用」的实验设计。

title: Benchmarking Answer-Grounding Consistency in Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering
comment: Under review at ICASSP 2027. Code available at https://github.com/pingggg516/AESP-Evaluation
summary: In grounded remote sensing visual question answering, a model produces a textual answer and identifies relevant objects in the image as grounding evidence. Existing evaluations measure answer correctness and localization quality, but do not directly assess answer-grounding consistency. We propose the Answer-Evidence Support Protocol (AESP) to assess this consistency through evidence support: whether the grounding evidence supports the model's own answer. AESP applies task-specific rules to existence, counting, and comparison questions. We further construct the Grounded Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering (G-RSVQA) benchmark, containing 15,027 samples with questions, reference answers, and all related object-level annotations. Experiments on seven grounded vision--language models reveal failures of evidence support across all three question types. Up to 50.82% of correct answers in the evidence evaluation subset are not supported by the provided grounding evidence.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Answer-Evidence Support Protocol（AESP），对存在、计数、比较三类问题按规则判定 grounding evidence 是否支持模型自己的答案，并构建含 15,027 个样本的 G-RSVQA 基准，在七个 grounded VLM 上发现证据支持普遍失败，多达 50.82% 的正确回答缺少证据支持。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于多模态推理的诊断与基准类工作，直接回应「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」以及视觉证据筛选问题，其 answer-grounding consistency 分析可供核查 VLM 推理中的视觉旁路与证据使用；但限于遥感领域，需进一步确认其规则化判定能否迁移到通用 latent 推理评估。

title: OccludeBench: Can VLMs Find What's Missing?
summary: How well can vision-language models (VLMs) reason about what is missing from an image? We study this question with OccludeBench, a manually curated benchmark for recovering fully occluded objects from the visual evidence that remains. OccludeBench distinguishes direct cases, where the hidden object must be recovered from a specific physical cue such as a shadow or reflection, from inferential cases, where it can be inferred from broader scene context. Across five VLMs, accuracy averages 42.7% on direct cases versus 62.7% on inferential cases, exhibiting a 20.0-point gap. Humans attain higher accuracies of 63.4% versus 68.5% for direct and inferential images, respectively, with no significant gap. To locate this failure, we introduce OccludeTrace, a four-stage diagnostic that isolates where the visual reasoning process breaks down. The bottleneck emerges when models must recover the relevant object from the projection within the full image: they succeed on only 50% of failed examples, compared with 91% of examples they answer correctly. Extended reasoning, tool use, and few-shot prompting yield inconsistent improvements and do not reliably eliminate the gap. In contrast, an inpaint-then-confront intervention, which prompts models to first generate a candidate hidden object and then evaluate that hypothesis against the visible physical cue, reduces the gap to a statistically non-significant difference for both models with image-generation capabilities. Together, our results establish a tractable, controlled diagnostic for isolating how VLMs reason about visual content that is missing from an image.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 OccludeBench，一个手工构建的基准，评测 VLM 能否从残留视觉证据中恢复被完全遮挡的物体，并区分依赖阴影、反射等物理线索的直接情形与依赖场景上下文的推理情形；同时提出四阶段诊断 OccludeTrace 定位失败环节，并对比延长推理、工具使用、few-shot 及先修复再对照等干预的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是针对 VLM 视觉推理缺失信息的诊断与失败分析工作，其发现瓶颈出现在「从整图中由投影恢复目标物体」这一步，且「先生成候选隐藏物体、再对照可见物理线索检验」的干预，可能为 latent 假设生成与视觉证据筛选的可核查线索。

title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
summary: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SpatialASM，用 allocentric novel-view 生成器构造显式 ASM 轨迹与视角采择任务，在训练时将主动空间心智化内化进 LVLM，并在七个空间推理基准上评估四个骨干模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉证据筛选、视角规划及「何时调用想象」的决策联系明确；其监督是显式 CoT 轨迹而非 latent 状态，推理期是否真正依赖内部场景模拟及其额外成本可供核查。

title: TreeHCA: Hindsight-Guided Exploration and Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
summary: Outcome-supervised group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) assigns the same advantage to every token in an LLM agent trajectory, leaving useful and unhelpful decisions undifferentiated. Hindsight credit assignment (HCA) can refine this feedback, but its estimates rely on trajectories containing informative alternatives at consequential histories. We introduce TreeHCA, which couples hindsight-guided exploration with hindsight credit assignment. TreeHCA uses changes in reference-answer likelihood to revisit intermediate histories and sample alternative continuations, forming a tree of reasoning and tool interactions. Because this exploration changes the distribution of sampled continuations, we derive the corresponding inverse-hindsight importance correction, including an exact finite-pool identity. We use this structure in a normalized tree backup that propagates terminal outcomes into turn-level advantages. This shared hindsight structure is TreeHCA's central design principle, linking informative exploration with hindsight-guided credit assignment. Across seven question-answering benchmarks and three Qwen backbones, TreeHCA outperforms all baselines in aggregate exact match, validating the effectiveness of paired exploration and credit assignment for multi-turn LLM agent training. Our code is available at github.com/TheBlackCat22/TreeHCA.

AI.brief_summary: TreeHCA 针对多轮 LLM agent 训练中 GRPO 对整条轨迹均匀分配优势的问题，将 hindsight 引导的探索与 hindsight 信用分配耦合：利用参考答案似然变化回访中间历史、采样替代续写形成推理与工具交互树，并推导相应的 inverse-hindsight 重要性修正与归一化树回传，把终局结果传播为 turn 级优势，在七个问答基准和三个 Qwen 主干上取得最优聚合 exact match。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把终局反馈回传为中间步骤（turn 级）优势的做法，可能为 latent 视觉推理中多步推理状态的贡献分配与轨迹监督提供方法借鉴，待核查这套树式 hindsight 信用分配能否迁移到含视觉证据筛选的推理轨迹。

title: Neural networks are more modular than single neurons suggest
summary: Neural networks routinely develop representations in which individual neurons contribute to multiple distinct functions, leading to the widespread view that such networks lack modular organization. We challenge this conclusion by introducing a formally nested hierarchy of modularity: unit-level, which requires distinct computations to occupy disjoint neurons; orthogonal, which asks whether a rotation reveals functionally independent subspaces; and linear, which asks whether a bounded linear map can separate task-relevant computations into independent subspaces. We develop a unified framework for learning decompositions at each level and evaluating them causally through selective ablation. Across vision models, language models and multi-task Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), we find that networks which lack unit-level modularity nonetheless often exhibit clear functional modularity at the subspace level. In vision and language models, content versus style and syntax versus semantics respectively dissociate under subspace ablation despite sharing overlapping populations of neurons. These learned subspaces also align differentially with brain data, with content and style subspaces predicting higher and lower visual cortex respectively, and semantic subspaces outperforming syntactic ones in predicting language cortex activity. In RNNs trained on multiple cognitive tasks and previously shown to lack modular structure, our decomposition recovers sharp double dissociations between tasks. The absence of unit-level modularity frequently coexists with clear subspace-level modularity across domains, enabling targeted intervention on specific computations even in networks where no individual neuron is specialized, with broad implications for mechanistic interpretability and for understanding functional organization in both biological and artificial neural systems.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出单元级、正交、线性三层嵌套的模块化定义，用统一框架学习各层分解并通过选择性消融做因果评估，在视觉模型、语言模型和多任务 RNN 中发现神经元层面不模块化的网络在子空间层面常呈现清晰的功能模块化（如内容与风格、语义与句法的分离）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其子空间分解与因果消融方法可供核查 LVR 的内部状态构成与使用，例如区分视觉内容与语义/风格子空间、检验答案是否真正依赖 latent 视觉信息，但该文未涉及多模态推理本身，迁移需自行设计。

title: One-Step Text Generation by Seq-Drifting
summary: Diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but still require multiple sampling steps to produce high-quality text. In this paper, we investigate whether a model can learn to generate an entire sequence in a single forward pass. We propose Seq-Drifting, a framework that applies drifting to sequences of continuous token representations and directly learns a map from Gaussian noise to text. Unlike existing DLMs that derive the supervision at each position directly from the observed token in a training sequence, Seq-Drifting builds a drift field whose position-wise targets adapt to the current generated context. At each position, attraction guides each output toward a set of contextually plausible token representations, while repulsion discourages collapse across samples and repetition within sequences. The generator learns from this drift field during training and produces all tokens jointly in one pass at inference. Empirically, Seq-Drifting achieves a generative perplexity of 36.01 on LM1B in one step and performs competitively in both unconditional and conditional generation. Experiments on translation, summarization, and reasoning further demonstrate the applicability of the framework beyond open-ended generation. These results suggest that drifting over token sequences offers a promising path toward effective one-step text generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/jyliu-ai/Seq-Drifting.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Seq-Drifting：将 drifting 用于连续 token 表示序列，学习从高斯噪声直接映射到整段文本，位置级漂移目标随当前生成上下文自适应，吸引项趋向上下文合理的表示、排斥项抑制样本间坍缩与序列内重复，在 LM1B 上一步生成取得困惑度 36.01。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「一步并行生成潜在序列 + 排斥项防坍缩」机制，可能为 LVR 中并行/少步 latent 推理状态生成与信息坍缩抑制提供方法线索，可供核查能否从纯文本迁移到视觉多模态推理状态。

title: GeoGR: Spatial-Semantic Token Compression and Group Routing for Efficient 3D VLMs
summary: Multi-view representations enable pretrained image and video vision-language models to understand 3D scenes, but their long visual token sequences make inference costly. Redundancy arises both from repeated observations of the same scene regions across views and from processing all visual tokens at every LLM layer, regardless of their relevance to the current computation. We propose GeoGR, a two-stage framework that jointly compresses scene representations and visual computation. At the projector level, GeoSemZip consolidates cross-view observations into 3D voxel tokens and combines semantic saliency with spatial coverage to construct a compact scene representation. Unselected voxel features are aggregated into contextual anchors to retain scene information that would otherwise be discarded. At the LLM level, we identify an effective visual computation window and observe that query-conditioned token relevance remains locally stable but changes over longer layer intervals. Guided by these findings, GroupRoute combines late entry and early exit with recoverable group-wise skipping. Low-relevance tokens bypass complete LLM layers while retaining their hidden states and can rejoin the active group at subsequent anchor layers selected under a computation budget. For compression-aware post-training, we construct a compact dataset of 67K samples by retaining 30% of the original training pool. With this protocol, GeoGR retains 95.2% and 96.8% of the dense post-trained models' performance on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Video-3D LLM-7B, respectively, while accelerating LLM prefill by $6.8\times$ and $6.1\times$. These results demonstrate the consistent effectiveness of GeoGR across 3D VLMs with and without explicit 3D spatial encoding, highlighting a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/GeoGR.

title: Travel Back To Move Forward: Retrospective Exploration and Evolving for Long Horizon Agents
summary: Large language model agents increasingly operate in long-horizon environments where early mistakes can trigger cascading failures and trap agents in dead-end trajectories. Agents must therefore be able to proactively recover from such states and turn their exploratory experience into guidance for subsequent decisions. We introduce ReTRAIL, a framework that enables agents to rewind the environment to earlier states while preserving valid progress and carrying forward knowledge learned from abandoned exploration. The environment state moves backward while the agent's knowledge continues to move forward. ReTRAIL trains a shared policy with two complementary signals: State-Anchored GRPO compares alternative continuations from revisited states to improve execution, while a branch-advancement reward guides reflection through the progress of subsequent exploration. Experiments across four interactive benchmark MineSweeper, Sokoban, ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that simply adding a rewind primitive provides limited benefit and can even degrade performance. In contrast, ReTRAIL enables agents to rewind from unproductive states and use insights from abandoned branches to guide subsequent exploration. These results demonstrate the value of coupling environment rewinding with experience reuse within an ongoing task for long-horizon task solving. The code is available at https://github.com/whi497/ReTRAIL.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ReTRAIL 框架：让长时程 LLM agent 在保留有效进展的前提下把环境回退到先前状态，并把被放弃探索分支中学到的知识继续带入后续决策；用两个信号训练共享策略——State-Anchored GRPO 比较同一回访状态下的不同续接，branch-advancement reward 借助后续探索进展引导反思。在 MineSweeper、Sokoban、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 上验证，发现单纯加入「rewind」原语收益有限甚至有害。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文以回访旧状态、比较多条续接并为其分配奖励的方式做轨迹级信用分配，可能为 LVR 中回溯式状态更新、搜索/验证与轨迹监督提供可迁移线索；但实验均为纯文本交互 agent，如何映射到视觉 latent 推理状态仍需核查。

title: Double-Take: Improving Capacity, Binding, and Selectivity In Long-Context Within Bidirectional Memory
summary: Processing a long sequence does not guarantee that distant information remains usable. As context grows, a fixed-size memory must retain many associations, connect information across positions, and preserve relevant structure without being overwhelmed by everything it observes. These are distinct requirements: a memory may store more information without representing the relationships needed for retrieval, and it may transport those relationships without preserving the ones that matter. Thus, the challenge is not simply extending context length, but constructing a memory that remains usable as context grows. We study this problem in large-chunk test-time training (TTT) and identify two basic failures: single-step writes accumulate interference, limiting capacity, while self-associative writes cannot form cross-position bindings. We introduce Double-Take (DT), which repairs these failures with multi-step unpinned updates and cross-position mixing, and adds bidirectional change-sensitive writes for selective retention. Capacity alone leaves end-to-end recall at the $0.10$ chance floor; adding binding raises it to $0.92$. Trained only on $32\,\mathrm{kb}$ genomic contexts, DT reaches $0.927$ AUROC at $131\,\mathrm{kb}$ and $0.856$ near $1\,\mathrm{Mb}$, while transferring zero-shot from human to mouse. Together, these results identify capacity, binding, and selectivity as three requirements for usable long-range memory.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究大块 test-time training 的长上下文记忆，指出单步写入累积干扰（容量受限）与自关联写入无法形成跨位置绑定两个失败，提出 Double-Take：以多步 unpinned 更新、跨位置混合和双向变化敏感写入来改善容量、绑定与选择性，并在长基因组序列和跨物种迁移上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽无视觉或多模态内容，但其「容量—绑定—选择性」三分与记忆写入设计（多步更新、跨位置绑定、变化敏感保留）可能对应 LVR 中 latent 状态如何写入更新、视觉细节与实体关系是否共同保留、以及选择性抑制干扰等问题，可供核查。

title: LongHarness: Advancing Agentic Reasoning over 100M-Token Corpora via Stateful Evidence Management
summary: Corpus-level long-context reasoning requires agents to acquire and integrate evidence across document collections that exceed their context windows. Existing agent harnesses enable incremental access to these corpora, but acquired evidence and evolving conclusions often remain entangled in a growing interaction history. This implicit state management can lead to two coupled failure modes: unbounded exploration, where retrieval expands the interaction history without resolving decision-relevant information gaps, and evidence-state drift, where previously acquired evidence or subsequent corrections fail to inform the current conclusion. We present LongHarness, a model-agnostic harness that makes the interaction between acquired evidence and evolving conclusions explicit. Its core mechanism, Evidence-Conclusion Coevolution, uses unresolved conclusions to guide exploration toward missing information, while newly acquired evidence strengthens or revises the conclusions that directed the search. LongHarness couples this process with Evidence Lifecycle Management, which keeps accumulated evidence current and traceable throughout the interaction. Together, these mechanisms focus retrieval on remaining information needs and keep conclusions aligned with current evidence. We evaluate LongHarness on OfficeQA Pro V1 and V2, AA-LCR, and LongBench v2 using GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash. Compared with direct reasoning using the same backbone, LongHarness improves GLM-5.3-Flash exact match on OfficeQA Pro from 15.8% to 60.2% on V1 and from 4.4% to 61.1% on V2. Against state-of-the-art agent harnesses, it surpasses Claude Code by 12.0 percentage points on V1 and Codex by 18.9 points on V2. With Qwen3.8-Flash, LongHarness reaches 61.7% on V1, outperforming Claude Code by 8.3 points and Codex by 12.0 points.

AI.brief_summary: LongHarness 是一个模型无关的 agent harness，面向超过上下文窗口的语料级长上下文推理，通过「证据—结论协同演化」和「证据生命周期管理」显式维护已获取证据与演化结论的关系，并在 OfficeQA Pro、AA-LCR、LongBench v2 等基准上验证提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其显式的证据状态追踪与结论对齐机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、状态更新与检索/停止决策提供借鉴线索，尤其是缓解「无界探索」和「证据—状态漂移」的设计值得核查，但属纯文本语料场景，迁移到多模态需自行判断。

title: State-OPD: State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring reasoning capabilities from frontier models to smaller models, while extending its success to multi-turn agentic environments remains challenging. We study agentic OPD through interaction states, distinguishing the objective task and executed action-observation record from the internal semantic trajectory of student reasoning. Through this lens, we identify two roles of student reasoning in multi-turn OPD: prior reasoning distorts teacher supervision, while current reasoning shapes the action alternatives sampled at the same state. Specifically, at matched interaction states, removing prior student reasoning improves teacher continuation success and changes the teacher's token-level targets, with larger continuation gains at later turns. Meanwhile, resampling complete reasoning-action responses yields greater action diversity at the same state than resampling actions under a fixed reasoning trace. We introduce State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation, a framework that grounds teacher supervision in interaction states and reallocates the sampling budget to generate multiple complete reasoning-action responses at states with high response entropy, while retaining full-history student generation. Comprehensive evaluations across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld and WebShop demonstrate that State-OPD achieves the highest macro-average success rate among the evaluated methods for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B students. Notably, for Qwen3-4B, State-OPD raises macro-average success from 26.07\% with the strongest baseline to 31.74\% and surpasses its Qwen3-32B teacher on ALFWorld Seen. Further analyses reveal that State-OPD achieves higher task success with fewer supervised turn responses and substantially reduces persistent failed-action repetition; qualitative traces illustrate decision revision based on interaction feedback.

AI.brief_summary: 本文研究多轮智能体中的 on-policy 蒸馏，区分客观交互状态（任务与动作-观察记录）与学生内部推理轨迹，提出 State-OPD：在匹配的交互状态上锚定教师监督，并按响应熵重新分配采样预算以生成多条完整推理-动作响应，在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上提升宏平均成功率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以交互状态锚定监督、区分先前推理与当前推理对教师目标的影响、按响应熵分配采样预算」的做法，可能为 LVR 训练中的轨迹监督、贡献分配与动态计算分配提供可核查的方法线索；但属纯文本多轮智能体，能否迁移到多模态 latent 推理状态仍需人工判断。

title: CAST: Credit Alignment for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
summary: Cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation (OPD) requires aligning teacher and student sequences before their scores can be compared. Decoded-text alignment provides such correspondence at the chunk level, but leaves a distinct problem unresolved: credit alignment. A chunk-level signal specifies how much a span should change, but not how that signal should be distributed across student tokens, while tokens without teacher correspondence remain unconstrained. We propose CAST (Chunk-aware credit Assignment with Selective Token Anchoring), a shift-or-stay framework that addresses both issues. For aligned chunks, CAST redistributes each chunk's advantage across student tokens using predictive uncertainty and local teacher-signal smoothness, emphasizing learning opportunities supported by locally consistent teacher feedback while preserving the chunk's total advantage. The resulting weights exactly solve a KL-regularized credit-allocation problem. For unaligned positions, CAST selectively anchors the student to its initial policy through a KL penalty, limiting drift where teacher supervision is unavailable. Because credit assignment is separated from chunk construction, CAST also applies to punctuation-defined or fixed-length chunks under shared tokenization. Across six mathematics, science, and code benchmarks, CAST improves the average over the strongest evaluated baseline by $2.45$ and $1.32$ points for cross-tokenizer transfer from Qwen3-8B to Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B, respectively, and by $2.10$ points for shared-tokenizer transfer to Qwen3-1.7B.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CAST，在跨 tokenizer 的 on-policy 蒸馏中把 chunk 级优势按预测不确定性与教师信号局部平滑度重新分配到学生 token，并对无教师对应的位置用 KL 惩罚选择性锚定初始策略，从而解决「信用对齐」问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「chunk 级信号如何分摊到各 token、无监督位置如何约束漂移」的信用分配与选择性锚定思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 步骤的贡献分配、监督缺失时的稳定化训练提供可核查的方法线索，但需确认其迁移到内部状态场景的可行性。

title: ConClick: Element-Wise Contrastive Learning Improves GUI Grounding
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, including references and appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/zhangruotian/ConClick
summary: GUI grounding, the task of locating the interface element specified by a user instruction, is a fundamental capability of GUI agents. However, existing grounding models remain error-prone, often causing downstream task failures. We systematically evaluate 10 grounding models across five datasets and identify a major error pattern: most incorrect clicks hit non-target interface elements rather than the background, with different models repeatedly selecting the same distractors. Motivated by these findings, we propose ConClick, a contrastive learning framework that teaches models to distinguish the target element from plausible distractors. We construct ConClick-Data, a dataset containing 4,292 challenging target-distractor pairs, and train the model using complementary listwise ranking and pairwise margin objectives. ConClick improves the grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B from 54.71% to 66.03% on ScreenSpot-Pro, from 83.72% to 86.28% on MMBench-GUI L2, and from 63.33% to 70.20% on OSWorld-G, outperforming prior methods built on the same or similarly sized backbones. We further introduce ReClick, an inference-time strategy that revisits promising regions and compares predictions across competing candidates, yielding an additional 2.96 percentage-point improvement in average accuracy across the three benchmarks. Together, our analysis, dataset, and methods provide both empirical insights and practical tools for building more reliable GUI agents. Data and code are available at https://github.com/zhangruotian/ConClick.

AI.brief_summary: 论文系统评估10个GUI grounding模型，发现多数错误点击落在非目标元素而非背景，且不同模型反复选中同一批干扰项；据此提出ConClick，用4,292对target-distractor数据结合listwise排序与pairwise margin对比学习，并给出推理期重访候选区域的ReClick策略。
